simple.meaning: מְעָה (mᵉʻâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “only in plural the bowels.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְעָה (H4577) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְעָה (H4577) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְעָה (mᵉʻâh) / H4577 is traced through Daniel 2:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4577. meah or mea [ מְעָא ] noun [masculine] plural external belly (see Biblical Hebrew [ מֵעֶה ] 6 ); — suffix מְע֫וֺהִי Dan 2:32 (of image in vision). מַעֲבַד see עבד . מְע֫וֺהִר see [ מְעָא ]. above, מֵעָל see עלל .
